item.title: Molson Coors planning $20 million ‘refresh’ at its Milwaukee office
item.description: Chicago-based Molson Coors Beverage Company is planning to renovate a portion of its Milwaukee office at 3939 W. item.title: Milwaukee Tool plans to create campus in Menomonee Falls for 2,000 employees
item.description: Milwaukee Tool’s planned multi-building expansion in Menomonee Falls could bring up to 2,000 employees and $205.8 million in new value.
